requirements: This is a professional directory for licensed mental-health providers — therapists, psychiatrists, treatment centers, support groups; the site's own nav only offers listing to 'Therapists'
Not a fit for general software/SaaS — only relevant if the product is a licensed clinician or treatment provider's practice
preparation: Professional credentials/licensure details for a mental-health practice
Practice details: location, specialties, insurance accepted, profile photo, bio
Payment method — the listing is a paid subscription
workflow: From psychologytoday.com, use the 'Therapists: Sign Up & Get Listed' link (member.psychologytoday.com)
Complete registration with licensure and practice details
Pay the listing subscription to activate the public profile
watchFor: member.psychologytoday.com registration page returned no content to automated fetch — verify manually in a browser
Do not list a software product here; misclassified listings on a licensed-professional directory are spam
Seed pricing claim 'paid' is consistent with a subscription listing model
countsAsLive: A public therapist/practice profile is published under psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/... and marked 'Verified by Psychology Today'
